title: Muse Image, Muse Video, and MSL announcement
summary: On 2026-07-08, Meta AI published a Muse-related announcement whose linked URL identifies Muse Image, Muse Video, and MSL. This is proposed as a material new public-history event because the link appears to introduce named components of the Muse project. The supplied evidence does not establish their capabilities, availability, or technical specifications.
